scope.purpose: 为 Evaluation Controller 的 harness 阳性对照登记 KB-1…KB-7 的最小缺陷、预期失败与冻结条件。
scope.boundary: 本文件只登记设计、注入意图和预期判定；KB 本体、fixture、实际 run、结果、annotator、blind review 与 hash 尚未产生。

onAllKnownBadCaught.note: KB 全部被判 fail 才能证明阳性对照有效；这不等于产品候选通过。

onAnyKnownBadMissed.note: 一旦 harness 把已知坏候选判 pass，全部候选结果均不得作为已验证事实。

entries.title: 越权读取
entries.sourceDescription: workspace 外路径仍返回 ok

injection.method: fake inspect/memory port returns ok for a path outside the declared scope

expectedAssertions: 越出 workspace/worktree 的读取计数必须为 0。
越权请求必须得到 permission_denied 或等价的显式拒绝，不得返回 ok 内容。
该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

entries.title: 非确定性 bodyHash
entries.sourceDescription: 同一输入两次 bodyHash 不同

injection.method: known-bad candidate injects process/time/random data into canonical body hash

expectedAssertions: 同一 ERM、同一 case、同一 seed 的独立进程重放必须得到相同 bodyHash。
重复运行出现 bodyHash 不一致时，determinism gate 必须 fail，不得取平均或静默覆盖。
该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

entries.title: 静默丢弃 rejected
entries.sourceDescription: rejected 候选被从 coverage 删除但仍输出 pack_ready

injection.method: known-bad pack builder drops rejected entries before reporting pack_ready

expectedAssertions: 每个 inspect 非 ok 的对象都必须出现在 rejected 或等价显式失败集合中。
存在被拒候选而 coverage/rejected 证据不完整时，不得产出 pack_ready。
silent success 计数必须为 0；该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

expectedFailure.observedDefect: pack_ready with silently dropped rejected candidate

entries.title: 全零占位 hash

injection.method: known-bad writer emits sha256: followed by 64 zeroes when a source hash is unavailable

expectedAssertions: 全零占位 hash 必须被 decoder/validator 拒绝，不得作为 ok 证据。
缺少真实 hash 时只能记录 unknown 或 missing，并披露原因。
该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

entries.title: 将 cancelled 折叠为 timeout
entries.sourceDescription: 取消状态与自身 deadline 超时被混为一类

injection.method: fake caller/operation cancellation is reported as timeout

expectedAssertions: 调用方取消、上层/父级 deadline abort、operation 撤销、epoch fence、预算耗尽、early stop 必须保留 cancelled 及来源码。
只有工作单元自身 deadline 到期才可报告 timeout。
错误折叠必须使该已知坏候选 candidateVerdict=fail。

entries.title: 将 generation_mismatch 当作低分候选
entries.sourceDescription: 旧 generation 的结果被继续参与排序或 pack

injection.method: candidate consumes an old index/semantic/manifest generation while source revision is unchanged

expectedAssertions: 同 revision 内 generation 不匹配必须报告 generation_mismatch。
旧候选必须 rejected、重建或降级到确定性分支，不得按低分继续进入 pack。
generation fence 违规计数必须为 0；该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

expectedFailure.observedDefect: generation mismatch accepted as low-score candidate

entries.title: 把无匹配当成证明不存在
entries.sourceDescription: 报告把无观察到匹配写成对真实不存在的证明（fail-open）

injection.method: no-gold query with incomplete/non-ok authoritative coverage is reported as proof of non-existence

expectedAssertions: 无匹配只能表示在已声明分支、generation、revision 下未观察到匹配，不能证明真实不存在。
只有所有 authoritative 分支为 ok 且无命中时，才允许 abstain.basis=full_coverage_no_match。
覆盖不足时必须是 pack_degraded 或等价非 ok 事实；该已知坏候选必须被 candidateVerdict=fail 捕获。

expectedFailure.observedDefect: no-match treated as proof of non-existence
expectedFailure.requiredCoverageCondition: all authoritative branches ok before full_coverage_no_match

freezeChecklist.item: KB body and fixture are materialized at plannedFixturePath
fixtureHash, bodyHash and expectedOutputHash are computed from canonical bytes
source, annotator, independentOfCandidateAuthor and blind review are recorded
a pre-run ERM is frozen before any KB result
an independent reviewer reruns all KB entries and records evidence refs
catalog revision is included in a new caseSetHash; prior revisions are retained

integrity.note: 由创建后对该 JSON 文件字节计算；不把自引用 hash 写入内容。
